approval.package: Approved at STAGE level: every declared exit criterion is attested (#93). See docs/*.md for each stage's reasoning.

note: Generated by `npm run handoff`. `snapshot` is a content hash of every CONTENT file in this package — data/, docs/, slices/ and PLAN.md. ⚠️ README.md and MANIFEST.json are NOT covered, because both embed the snapshot and cannot be inside it. Identical content and tool version therefore produce an identical snapshot; the converse does NOT hold if the TOOL changed without its version changing — see QST-0016. There are deliberately no timestamps here: a timestamp would make two identical plans look different, which is the opposite of what an identifier is for.
